sourceRefs.locator: Attestation 1135, place and original wording Clippiaco. The modern identification is Saint-Ouen-sur-Seine; the translation renders the place Clichy. Used for geographical orientation only.

ARTEM 4504, Archives nationales K 1 no. 5, transmission, place, regest and ll. 1–3. Address to the duke, the domesticus Gaganricus and the agents, the estate and its former owners. The dated header gives 15 March 633.
ARTEM 4511, Archives nationales AE II 6 (K 2 no. 3). Header, regest and ll. 3–4, naming the king’s parents Dagobert and Nanthild as buried in the basilica. Clichy, 22 June 654.
Communes endpoint, centre: Paris (75056), 2.347° E, 48.8589° N, and Clichy (92024), 2.3041° E, 48.9041° N. Rounded editorial orientation for the locality only.

processingNote.de: Der Ausschnitt umfasst das Gebiet bei Clichy und Vieux Saint-Ouen an der Seine. Er lässt die Lage einzelner Räume des frühmittelalterlichen Hofes offen.
processingNote.en: This area covers Clichy and Vieux Saint-Ouen along the Seine. The location of individual buildings of the early medieval court remains open.
